notes: Every node is its own Box<Node> with Option<Box<Node>> children (a null pointer for a leaf).
Dropping a tree frees it recursively, node by node, through musl's malloc (the pinned toolchain's default allocator).
Digits are checked explicitly because str::parse::<u32> also accepts a leading '+'.
Release profile: opt-level 3, fat LTO, 1 codegen unit; static musl binary on a scratch image.
